description: This Kotlin file defines the TimerSchedulerViewModel class which is a ViewModel responsible for scheduling lock/hide rules in an Android application. It uses dependency injection to obtain a scheduler and provides a method to schedule lock rules based on a package name and trigger time.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class for scheduling lock rules triggered at a specified time.

methods.name: scheduleLock
methods.description: Schedules a lock rule for the specified package name at the given trigger time.
